predicates.meaning: One physical holder at a time.
One authoritative owner in the v0.1 model; ownership never follows possession implicitly.
One coarse zone location at a time.
One containing room at a time.
One controlling actor for this v0.1 proposition slot.
One primary focus; ambient awareness is represented separately.
A room or object may be accessible to several actors.
Access may independently be denied to several actors.
Information may be disclosed to several actors.
An entity may be visible to several actors.
An object may have outstanding offers to actors; no holder transfer is implied.
Availability may hold for several actors and does not imply acceptance.
